text.description_html:
INOX RA213L475, Half Passage Stainless Steel Cabernet Leverset with Wood Detail

The Half Passage Cabernet Wood and Stainless Lever has a modern look. Its naturally deep color of the wooden inlay paired with the stainless steel of the lever and rosette shows us how INOX masterfully blends materials for a stunning end product. The Cabernet Lever with RA Rosette is a half passage function. This lever set includes a lever that retracts the latch from one side of the door and a bore hole cover plate for the other side of the door. Half passage functions are ideal of closets that need to latch and have been pre-drilled. Choose from satin stainless steel and polished stainless steel finishes.

Half Passage: For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from one side of door. The other is a blank plate to cover standard door bore hole preparation. Package Includes: 1 levers, 1 roses, 1 cover plate, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Features of the Half Passage Cabernet Lever with RA Rosette:

  • Hollow stainless steel lever.
  • Latch: 28 Degrees Retraction (TL4 Latch)
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the INOX 213 Cabernet Lever with RA Rosette:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel with Wood Insert on Lever
  • Lever Length: 5-5/16"
  • Lever Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Rose Dimeter: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Projection: 7/16"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Hub and Spindle: 5/16" (8mm) Square
  • Latch Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" Standard Square Corner
  • Latch Strike: Full Lip Strike and T-Strike with Square Corners.

Note: Half Passage Functions are Handed Handing Guide
